description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers for four language pair conditions: en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 22 without specified units, displaying numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.45, also without specified units, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four solid lines without markers. The dark red line, representing "en&en", begins at approximately 0.08 on the y-axis, rises to a sharp peak of roughly 0.32 at layer 4, drops to 0.22 at layer 5, and forms a broader peak near 0.27 around layers 10 and 11. It then fluctuates slightly, dipping to 0.22 at layer 16 before rising sharply after layer 20 to end above the 0.45 mark. The light blue line, representing "en&es", follows a similar trajectory, starting at 0.07, peaking at 0.30 at layer 4, dropping to 0.20 at layer 5, and reaching a broad peak of 0.26 at layers 10 and 11. It dips to 0.20 at layer 17 and ends with a sharp increase to approximately 0.42 at the final layer. The light green line, representing "en&el", starts lower at 0.05, peaks at 0.19 at layer 4, drops to 0.14 at layer 5, and rises to a broad peak of 0.23 at layer 10. It dips to 0.17 at layer 17 before spiking to approximately 0.43 at the end of the x-axis. Finally, the light pink line, representing "en&bn", closely tracks the light green line, starting at 0.04, peaking at 0.19 at layer 4, dropping to 0.14 at layer 5, and reaching 0.22 at layer 10. It dips to 0.17 at layer 17 and concludes with a sharp rise to approximately 0.43 at the final layer.
